contract: open a preloaded regular MP4 file through 32 KiB random-access input
read one AVC video stream and one AAC or Opus audio stream through EOF in demux order
seek cases read one packet, seek backward using the video clock, then read the complete suffix
compare track ID, PTS, DTS, duration, source extent, flags, trim and payload for every emitted packet
compare the original AAC timing runs and a variant with an interior duration longer than one coded frame
compare Opus edit-list trim, unequal packet durations, and MOV secondary-track alignment at a backward seek boundary
opus-roll cases use the audio sample at the actual video landing to select the source roll group and decoder start
compare the video landing extent, audio sync and start ordinals, and preroll in 48 kHz samples before comparing the complete suffix
the reference reads the roll tables and uses the public MOV audio index and seek, omitting video packets before the selected landing
